config.split_use: field_test, scored with everything fitted on field_dev
config.override_note: The user asked for this field_test measurement of the E18 question engine after E9's one run: no model is scored again; the saved field_test probabilities of E9's improved_calibrated rows are the inputs and every fitted number is frozen in configs/e18_params.json (fitted on field_dev only) before any test row is read.

grower.note: Answers written by six separate Sonnet agents, one batch of classes each, given only the question text (ids anonymised, the two question banks mixed and shuffled), the true condition's name and guide excerpts of that condition, never the question's support sets. The guide excerpts are the same documents the questions were written from, so this grower is better informed than a real grower and the perfect-grower row is an upper bound.

systems.photo_only: the final model's calibrated probabilities, no questions
systems.plant_only: the plant question only, answered with the true plant when it is among the plants the photo fits
systems.new_perfect: plant question, then the new questions answered by the simulated grower's table
systems.new_flip10: as new_perfect with 10% of yes/no answers flipped (seed 0 saved; 20 seeds in seeds_summary)
systems.new_flip20: as new_perfect with 20% of yes/no answers flipped
systems.new_unsure20: as new_perfect with 20% of answers replaced by not sure
systems.e11_original_rule: the 52 E11 questions (38 touch the 29 classes), the E11 rule (x3 yes, x0.5 no, 2 questions, no plant question), simulated grower
systems.e11_live_rule: the same questions with the live demo's old rule (plant first, x3 yes, x0.35 no, up to 5 steps), simulated grower
